source: USGS 3DEP CA_AlamedaCo_2_2021 ground returns (class 2), via Entwine
method: mean of the ground returns in each 2.0 m cell; empty cells filled from neighbours out to 6 cells; holes still open are grown into from their edge a cell a step, out to 60 cells; 2% of returns held out and compared with the bilinear grid at their position
sensor_accuracy_note: USGS states about 0.10 m RMSEz for this collection; the figures here are the grid's own error on top of that, measured against held-out returns of the same lidar.

waterline.note: cells inside the map's closed water polygons, and on the seaward side of its coastlines out to ground more than LAND_M over the water, were set to the water surface the lidar measured; the renderer draws the sea at and under that surface
